sections.title: CORAL B-300
sections.overview:
B-300 (walnut finish) :   125,000 (1 piece, around 1980)(black finish) :   115000 (1 piece, around 1980)B-301 (walnut finish) :   40,000 (1 piece, around 1980)(black finish) :   35000 (1 piece, around 1980)

The front load horn enclosure was also used as a monitor system for the theatre.A 2-way system can be configured by combining with a horn box B-301 of a different specification.There are 2 variations of the appearance, walnut finish and black finish.
